description: This script rewrites GitHub wiki URLs in a file to local markdown references, decoding special characters and adding a marker to prevent reprocessing.

methods.name: rewrite_wiki_links
methods.description: Rewrites wiki URLs in a given file to local markdown links, creating a marker file to prevent reprocessing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Iterates over command-line arguments (file paths) and processes each with rewrite_wiki_links.
